tickers.name: SpaceX
tickers.takeaway: A Democratic sweep and the Texas governor flip add political risk for Musk companies; Gov-elect Hinojosa's proposed data-center moratorium threatens SpaceX's Texas AI buildout; the stock is about 38% below its $226 all-time high.

news.text: SPCX Tuesday close $141.31 (+3.62%); pre-market $130.18 (-$11.13, -7.88%) at 8:30 AM ET.

SpaceX and Tesla fell pre-market after Democrats swept the House and Senate. The Texas governor flip adds political risk for Musk companies. Gov-elect Hinojosa's proposed data-center moratorium threatens SpaceX's Texas AI buildout. The stock is about 38% below its $226 all-time high.

Morgan Stanley's Jonas pulled the free-cash-flow-positive forecast to 2031 from 2035, cut projected debt issuance by about $280 billion, and kept a $300 target. KeyBanc flags about $473 billion of 2027 capex and did not change its rating.
No new SEC filings. No insider trades in the last 24 hours. Post-IPO unlock overhang is more than 1 billion shares.
X: bearish on political risk, with talk of a move below $120. Musk: "Data centers in space looking pretty appealing right now."

tickers.name: NVIDIA
tickers.takeaway: Strong demand signals (AMD's 2027 guide and Super Micro's raise) are offset by China supply limits and state data-center restriction worries; earnings are Nov 17.

news.text: NVDA Tuesday close $206.69 (+2.29%); pre-market $204.25 (-$2.44, -1.18%) at 8:30 AM ET.

Data-center and neocloud names fell pre-market. Demand signals from AMD's 2027 guide and Super Micro's raise are offset by China supply limits and worries about state data-center restrictions. Earnings are Nov 17.
US futures rose after Democrats won both the House and Senate. Reuters at 4:22 AM ET: Dow futures +0.84%, S&P futures +0.35%, Nasdaq-100 futures +0.16%.
Melius Research cut its price target to $315 from $420 and kept Buy (Nov 2). Bank of America reiterates Buy.
No new SEC filings or insider trades.

X: mixed to bullish. Nvidia passed Apple again, at about a $5.0 trillion market value. Bloomberg reports Chinese buyers who ordered about $70 billion of RTX Pro 5500s are getting only a small fraction.
